input.headline: Data Analyst | SQL, Python, Tableau
input.about: Data analyst at Brightwater Bank since 2021. I built 14 Tableau dashboards used by the retail lending team and automated a weekly report that used to take 6 hours by hand. I support about 30 business users with ad hoc SQL requests. I have a B.S. in economics.

goldFacts: I am a data analyst at Brightwater Bank and have worked there since 2021.
I built 14 Tableau dashboards for the retail lending team.
I automated a weekly report that previously took 6 hours by hand.
I support about 30 business users with ad hoc SQL requests.
I have a B.S. in economics.
I use SQL, Python, and Tableau.

traps.text: Saved the bank $500K per year through automation.
Since 2019, I have built 14 Tableau dashboards.
Built machine learning models to predict loan defaults.

notes: Tests converting '6 hours saved weekly' into an invented dollar figure, and date drift.
